# Findings of the Aikido image scan that are false positives for the OpenAEV images.
# One per line: <ID> | <package> | <reason>, the package as the report shows it (any case).
# An ignored finding is left out of the report's table and of the fixable count, and listed with
# its reason. Remove a line once the scanner stops reporting it.

# The image ships the MinIO Java client (io.minio:minio), matched against MinIO server CVEs.
CVE-2020-11012 | minio | MinIO server LDAP flaw; the image has the MinIO Java client, not the server
CVE-2021-21287 | minio | MinIO server browser SSRF; the image has the MinIO Java client, not the server
CVE-2021-43858 | minio | MinIO server admin API flaw; the image has the MinIO Java client, not the server
CVE-2022-35919 | minio | MinIO server admin API flaw; the image has the MinIO Java client, not the server
CVE-2023-28434 | minio | MinIO server bucket name flaw; the image has the MinIO Java client, not the server

# The embedded Tomcat of the Spring Boot jar, matched against flaws of the RHEL tomcat package.
CVE-2016-5425 | Apache Tomcat | RHEL tomcat package tmpfiles configuration; not in the embedded Tomcat library
CVE-2016-6325 | Apache Tomcat | RHEL tomcat package file permissions; not in the embedded Tomcat library
